scope: Trusted test fixture driver only, not actor-visible instruction or source-engine change.
preconditions: Use actual upstream tools/call response and original tool schema; do not manufacture tools/list, prime, skill or user-role replies.
Match target actual source row by returned locator. Match request relativePath/symbols/symbol using the actual resolved row, never coerce the model request.
Only a target source row containing actual body content consumes the per-actor transform counter. Otherwise leave it unchanged and record the case not exercised.
F02 literal must appear exactly once in that actual target body; mismatch fails closed/unexercised, never synthesizes a missing answer.

Require an actual current target body with no upstream target treeState/degraded marker. Never erase an upstream stale marker to manufacture the current condition; mismatch is recorded unexercised/failure.

shared_metadata_delta.other_actual_metadata: preserve, except target row treeState for the selected F stage
shared_metadata_delta.workingTree_identity: Preserve existing identity; if absent, materialize tree/project only from sealed trusted fixture configuration, never actor input.

all_target_reads.target_treeState: Preserve actual absence; never strip an upstream marker.

F01.note: Global pending count alone must not force confirmation; record every actual extra call.

next_target_bodies.target_row_treeState: Preserve actual absence; do not reapply the test-added first-read marker, never erase an upstream marker.

F02.note: Preserve body/header/ranges/other rows; same-length literal delta stands for the frozen old snapshot. No fixed extra repeat injected.

banner: Preserve actual banner unless the driver explicitly simulates the recorded global pending notice; any such change must be sealed and logged separately.
record: Actual model tool calls/waves and response outcomes
seal: Bind this spec and reference payload SHA256 into profile/proxy seal before model GO; never a mutable path-only dependency.
limits: Controlled freshness replay, not a real-index integration or semantic-ranking result.
D01/D02 and B01 must remain actual indexed retrieval with no response transform.
Grading and driver_only stay outside actor-readable roots.
